title: NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) Renewal Servicing Calendar
content:
Tidemark's renewal servicing schedule for the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) applies the same figures on all tiers.

| Tier | Renewal bill issued before expiration (calendar days) | Renewal grace period after expiration (calendar days) | Renewal bill also sent to the mortgagee of record when mortgage-required |
|---|---|---|---|
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Condominium Unit | 45 | 30 | yes |
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Manufactured Building | 45 | 30 | yes |
| NFIP General Property Form – Other Residential Building | 45 | 30 | yes |
| NFIP General Property Form – Non-Residential Building | 45 | 30 | yes |
| NFIP RCBAP – Two-to-Four Unit Condominium Building | 45 | 30 | yes |
| NFIP RCBAP – Five-or-More Unit Condominium Building | 45 | 30 | yes |

- **Renewal notice — 45 calendar days.** Days before expiration Tidemark issues the renewal bill under its servicing schedule.
- **Renewal grace — 30 calendar days.** The grace period after expiration in which the full renewal premium keeps coverage continuous.
- **Mortgagee copy.** On every tier the renewal bill is also sent to the mortgagee of record when the policy is mortgage-required.

**Calendar illustration (hypothetical).** For a term ending on 1 June, the renewal bill goes out 45 days earlier, on 17 April, and the grace period runs 30 days to 1 July.

## Parameter meanings

- Days before expiration Tidemark issues the renewal bill under its servicing schedule; calendar days.
- Grace period after expiration in which the full renewal premium keeps coverage continuous; calendar days.
- Whether the renewal bill is also sent to the mortgagee of record when the policy is mortgage-required; boolean.
